crossRefs.note: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

translations.web: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: The rest of the oil in his palm, the priest is to put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
translations.asv: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah.
